findings.note: Native MetaBlooms OS source resides in /mnt/data/Metablooms_OS (sandbox). The STAAR repo carries proof artifacts and governance records only.

hook_path_coverage: repeat_blocker_forces_rca → hook exit 2 on second call (FORCE_RCA)
changed_inputs_not_repeat → hook exit 0 on second call (LOG_NEW_VARIANT)

PreToolUse_tool_route_guard.detail: .claude/settings.json is present in the repo. Claude Code will enforce PreToolUse hook for all tool calls in future sessions on this repo. file_search with any /mnt/data or Metablooms_OS string (in any field, including arrays and nested dicts) is blocked with exit 1. All other tools pass through safely.

PostToolUseFailure_repeated_blocker_guar.detail: Hook is wired and the script runs without error. However, the exact JSON payload that Claude Code sends on PostToolUseFailure has not been validated against the blocker event schema in a live session. The script accepts any JSON dict and fingerprints whatever fields it finds; blocker_type/component/operation/normalized_command/target_path will all be empty strings for a raw Claude Code failure event, producing a low-discrimination fingerprint until a format adapter is built. The wiring is correct; semantic accuracy of RCA routing from live tool failures requires format adapter work in the next stage.

limitations: PostToolUseFailure hook format: Claude Code's native failure payload has not been mapped to the blocker event schema. All structural fields will be empty in live hook invocations; fingerprints will have low discrimination until a thin format adapter is added.

PreToolUse matcher '*' runs tool_route_guard.py for every tool call (minor subprocess overhead per call). Narrowing to 'file_search' would reduce overhead but miss aliased/namespaced tool names that canonicalize to file_search.

Ledger file governance/blocker_ledger/ledger.json is written by the PostToolUseFailure hook in live sessions. This file should be added to .gitignore to avoid accidental commits of session-specific blocker state.

Live session hook behavior depends on Claude Code reading .claude/settings.json at session startup. Hook enforcement is only active in Claude Code CLI/app sessions on this repo, not in plain Python or CI contexts.
Native MetaBlooms OS source (/mnt/data/Metablooms_OS) is absent from this repo; no OS-level boot or mpp.sh integration is performed here.
